title: support alerts
description:
> [!note] 
> The following information is useful.


- note (i circled icon/emoji) — blue when color, with blue border left when color
- tip (light bulb icon/emoji) — green
- important (exclamation mark in speech bubble) — purple
- caution (exclamation mark in triangle) — dark yellow/gold
- warning (exclamation mark in stop sign shape) — red

idea: make an existing blockquote or quote to an alert with CTRL+a - show a selection then or use a chord

also  with  blockquote:

>>> [!note] Things to consider
You should consider the following ramifications:

1. consideration 1
2. consideration 2
>>>
